additionalClassificationDefect.finding: The retained body explicitly identifies a paid Xage issuer release syndicated by GlobeNewswire on Yahoo Finance. This is not independent editorial reporting.

proposedSourceClass.basis: The enum already includes OFFICIAL and IR. Existing attributed issuer releases use both; no dedicated syndicated-release class exists. OFFICIAL is the proposed issuer-release label, not an automatic admitted change.

additionalClassificationDefect.currentCorrectionPolicyLimit: The existing factual correction validator protects evidence sourceClass and organization. A separately reviewed dated metadata route or explicit policy extension is needed before publication. Do not edit originals or the five draft requests.

validatorLocations.rule: EVIDENCE_MUTABLE excludes sourceClass and organization; every other original evidence field must be identical.
evidenceChanges excludes sourceClass and organization; unchanged evidence properties must compare equal.
load_policy accepts source evidence only when its immutable class is IR,FILING or OFFICIAL. TR-xage-1 remains INDEPENDENT today; a proposed correction cannot bypass this guard.

limitations.before: Trade-press relay of company-stated figures; not independently confirmed against a direct Xage or Piva Capital primary release, though an SEC Form D filed the same date (2026-03-18) is consistent with a Reg D raise around this period.
limitations.after: This is a paid Xage Security press release distributed by GlobeNewswire and republished by Yahoo Finance. Growth figures are company-reported; this source is not independent editorial reporting. The release does not disclose an absolute revenue figure.

minimalDatedCorrectionRecommendation.preserve: All other evidence fields, including organization, identity, canonical URL, excerpt and original retrieval metadata, remain exactly unchanged. The limitations clarify carrier versus issuer without rewriting original attribution.
minimalDatedCorrectionRecommendation.implementationBoundary: Propose a single-record, exact-before-hash exception for only this sourceClass transition, with ordinary whole-group source-byte binding and real independent review. Do not add sourceClass or organization to a general mutable-fields list. Preserve the primary-source guard generally; any exceptional paid-release proof admission must be equally confined to this exact record and retained body.

qualificationActions.action: Start with retained named SiliconANGLE stories for Chainguard and Claroty. Qualify an exact recurring scope; the literal security category and author archives are broad leads, not supplier-complete feeds.

For Cyera, JFrog, Rapid7, Rubrik, Trend Micro and Xage, retain literal distributor datelines and any original-story links. Obtain real distributor organization/index/feed responses in the next authorized fetch window. Company-owned feeds stay official_announcements.
Inspect origin and publisher labels for Help Net Security Industry News, Tracxn profiles and syndicated material. Do not substitute them for independently authored editorial reporting.

Prepare a separate dated metadata correction proposal for TR-xage-1 with preserved Yahoo/GlobeNewswire/Xage attribution and a reviewed path for protected sourceClass changes. Keep the fixed177 semantic audit, five existing draft groups and all original records unchanged.

For blocked Bloomberg/ResearchPool and references with no retained body, keep the gap explicit and seek a public accessible alternative within the existing family. Do not bypass access controls or broaden subscriptions.

A later qualified recurring binding must prove supplier selection, publication scope, pagination or terminal response and retained-window completeness, then replace exactly one missing-family task. Shared publisher homepages and story bytes cannot establish silence.

ownerOnlyChoice.reason: Public source qualification and a dated correction proposal remain agent-owned. No paid access, family waiver, new subscription or silent reclassification is proposed.

limits: Only exact retained observation/body bytes and literal HTML attributes support the findings. Reference labels without a body remain unverified leads.
Publisher material is classified by article byline, explicit paid/wire dateline or profile labels, not by a declared sourceClass alone.
A historical article, company profile, generic feed link or publisher homepage is not a complete qualified recurring source and proves no quiet outcome.
No parent or acquirer article is silently attributed to a product segment. Supplier body mentions use only declared names and aliases.
